title: California ZIP/ZCTA Distributed Energy Resource Equity Dataset (2023)
description: ZIP/ZCTA-level dataset for California integrating rooftop solar PV, battery storage, EV charging infrastructure, wind, and power-plant capacity with American Community Survey demographic predictors, NASA POWER climate controls, electric utility territory, electricity demand, and energy-burden measures. Built for equity analysis across multiple DER types under a consistent set of outcomes and controls. See README.md in this record for contents, provenance, and reproduction instructions.
notes: Raw third-party inputs are not redistributed in this record. They are public and are cited with retrieval URLs in SOURCES.md, and scripts/fetch_exact_public_data.py downloads the pinned snapshots.
